generation: Local source patches and clause/sentence permutations; no wholesale LLM rewriting and no trained B weights. Same root claims, requested tone, target references and immutable V6 A artifact throughout.
execution_host: Mac Studio for parsing, A scoring, Rust builds and tests; laptop only for lightweight coordination, HTTP and the original cumulative budget ledger.
editorial_reviews: Non-independent assistant judgments. Root and complete candidate reviewed each time. Earlier adaptive results known; new combination A scores also known for pg6. No independent preservation, preference or author-identification evaluation.
search_amendments: 0.40 to 0.75 before pg2, recording the same root and reason
0.75 to 1.0 before pg5b, recording the same root and reason; pg5 remained unscored with 41 states and 23 cumulative-distance exclusions
Moved trial purpose paired with explicit these arrangements before any pg5b scores to avoid an ambiguous pronoun

budget.ledger: spend is recorded in the private ledger

quality_policy: Meaning and intended tone are hard constraints. Writing must not regress; final outputs need an explicit editorial improvement, separate from detector or vector scores. Neutral probes can inform search but do not establish a quality benefit.
limitations: One familiar development notice, one target author represented by two imperfect excerpts
Every Pangram observation has zero human fraction; 0% fully AI can mean 100% AI-assisted
Count-vector invariance does not imply invariance of detectors or quality
No held-out result, no trained B model, no attestation, no whitepaper milestone
